The story behind the table

More than a meal.
A moment together.

“Sofra” means a table set for a meal. It is the idea at the heart of our restaurant: good things happen when people sit down together.

Our kitchen takes its inspiration from the Mediterranean — bright herbs, good olive oil, and ingredients that speak for themselves. Our dining room is made for unhurried lunches, long conversations, and one more bite.
